photos.alt: A smiling toddler in a turquoise striped dress claps her hands while standing in sunlit tall green grass.
photos.colors: fresh green, aqua blue, warm skin tones
photos.notes: Landscape 3:2. Toddler sits right of centre with soft blurred green grass on the left, so put the headline on the left half and keep object-position right. Bright, soft sunlight; best full-bleed under a gentle butter-yellow or white wash.

photos.alt: A small boy in a striped shirt, seen from the side, reaches toward dozens of soap bubbles floating in a shady park.
photos.colors: deep green, warm cream, iridescent bubble highlights
photos.notes: Landscape 3:2. Child turned away so no clear face. Bubbles fill the upper right; keep the top half in view when cropping. Slightly dark and moody, so lighten with a pastel overlay or place it in a rounded card.

photos.alt: Two smiling girls sit with their arms around each other on a pastel striped picnic blanket beside a wicker basket holding a baguette, juice bottles, an orange and a muffin, with a white sun hat on the lawn.
photos.colors: peach, powder blue and blush stripes, lawn green, white
photos.notes: Portrait about 3:4 (1200x1553). Faces in the upper half, basket and snacks in the lower half, so a 4:5 or tall-card crop at 50% 50% keeps both; for a landscape crop use object-position 50% 55%. Replaces the grapes, chips and cherries flat lay, which clashed with a toddler snack list (chips, whole cherries). Girls are older than the guests, which is fine for a picnic mood shot. No legible brands.

photos.alt: A toddler with twisted braids, a navy jumper and beige trousers sits barefoot in warm sand holding a toy dinosaur among colourful wooden shape-sorter pieces, with soft green grass behind.
photos.colors: warm sand, navy, grass green, primary toy colours
photos.notes: Portrait 4:5, sharp and sunlit with a calm blurred green top third. Crop square or 4:5 at object-position 50% 60% so the face and toys both stay in frame. Replaces the Polesie Toys sandbox shot, which had a legible POLESIE brand name on a toy boat. No logos in this one.

photos.alt: Overhead view of a toddler seen from behind reaching out to paint on a white floor splashed with bright paints, brushes and paint pots.
photos.notes: Landscape 3:2 on a clean white ground, so there is lots of calm space around the child. No face visible. Works as a section banner or a tilted sticker-style card.

photos.alt: A red-haired toddler in a beige tee builds a row of natural wooden blocks and towers on a pale floor beside a wooden toy train.
photos.colors: natural wood, cream white, soft ginger
photos.notes: Portrait 2:3. Seen from above with the face turned down. Calm, neutral and light, so it takes pastel colour washes well. Crop to 4:5 and keep the blocks in the lower two thirds.

photos.alt: A toddler in a white polo shirt toddles toward the camera holding a colourful ring toy while two smiling women in white blouses sit chatting on a white blanket in a sunlit park behind him.
photos.colors: sunlit green, white linen, warm gold
photos.notes: Landscape 3:2. Toddler plays in the foreground while two grown-ups relax and talk on a blanket, which is the parents-chatting-while-kids-play idea (no coffee in shot). Toddler sits left of centre and the women right of centre, so keep the full width or crop gently at 50% 50%. Warm golden light suits the parent-info panel. Replaces the cherry-blossom park shot, which was crowded with strangers and showed the adults playing with the child rather than chatting.

photos.alt: A girl in a white dress arranges a pastel garden party table decorated with flowers, teddy bears, pink cups, paper pom-poms and bunting in front of a pale blue wooden house.
photos.colors: powder blue, blush pink, white, lawn green
photos.notes: Portrait 2:3. The best overall mood match: pastel bunting, pom-poms, flowers and soft light. Crop to 4:5 or a tall card; keep the table and the pom-poms in frame.

photos.alt: Three small children seen from behind sitting together in golden meadow grass in front of a backlit tree canopy.
photos.colors: leaf green, golden grass, warm shadow
photos.notes: Second hero candidate, portrait 2:3. Dreamy and backlit, children from behind (no faces). Dark leafy upper half gives calm space for a headline on a tall mobile hero; for a landscape crop use object-position 50% 82%.

photos.alt: Two children seen from behind sit side by side on a grey quilted blanket on sunlit grass, each holding an open picture book.
photos.colors: lawn green, slate grey, floral orange and purple
photos.notes: Story-circle spare, landscape 3:2. Faces turned away, so no identifiable faces. Use for the story-circle step of the plan. The book pages show only small illustrations; one has the word ZOO in a drawing, nothing branded. Replaces the finger-paint hands shot, which showed a partly legible diaper brand and repeated the crafts slot.

photos.alt: Two babies in soft green and pale printed outfits sit back to back on a grassy slope under tall trees, both smiling and looking off to the side.
photos.colors: sage green, cream, blush bow, soft brown
photos.notes: Portrait 2:3, soft muted greens, babies in profile. Friends-coming or RSVP card. Crop to 4:5 at object-position 50% 55%. Replaces the pastel bunting close-up, which came from the same shoot and house as the garden photo.
